title: Convert between number bases
prompt: Read lines from standard input; each should hold `NUMBER FROM TO`, three fields separated by single spaces. FROM and TO are bases written as decimal integers (digits only) from 2 to 36. NUMBER is written in base FROM: an optional minus sign followed by one or more digits, where the digits are `0`-`9` then `a`-`z` (uppercase letters are accepted and mean the same), each below FROM. For every line (empty lines included) print NUMBER converted to base TO, with lowercase letters, no leading zeros (zero is `0`) and a leading `-` for a negative value (so `-0` prints `0`). Print `invalid` if the line does not have this form or any field is not valid. Every valid NUMBER fits in 48 bits.
